en.text: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. From omega of I equals 1, the program follows preserved identity.

translations.en: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. From omega of I equals 1, the program follows preserved identity.
translations.fr: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. À partir d’oméga de I égal à 1, le programme suit l’identité préservée.
translations.pt-BR: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. A partir de ômega de I igual a 1, o programa acompanha a identidade preservada.
translations.zh-Hans: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica。从 ω(I) 等于 1 出发，程序追踪保持的恒等性。

en.text: ONTO: illustrative geometry. INPUT: the cosmic setting. Now the boundary takes shape.

translations.en: ONTO: illustrative geometry. INPUT: the cosmic setting. Now the boundary takes shape.
translations.fr: ONTO : géométrie illustrative. INPUT : décor cosmique de présentation. La frontière prend maintenant forme.
translations.pt-BR: ONTO: geometria ilustrativa. INPUT: ambiente cósmico de apresentação. Agora a fronteira toma forma.
translations.zh-Hans: ONTO：示意几何。INPUT：宇宙展示背景。现在边界开始成形。

en.text: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.

translations.en: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.
translations.fr: L’autoconjugaison fait de la frontière son propre complément. Son point fixe vaut 0,5.
translations.pt-BR: A autoconjugação torna a fronteira seu próprio complemento. Seu ponto fixo é 0,5.
translations.zh-Hans: 自共轭使边界成为自身的补集。不动点为 0.5。

en.text: In this derivation, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. The associated volume is the square root of e.

translations.en: In this derivation, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. The associated volume is the square root of e.
translations.fr: Dans cette dérivation, l’entropie de frontière vaut 0,5 nat. Le volume associé est la racine carrée de e.
translations.pt-BR: Nesta derivação, a entropia da fronteira é 0,5 nat. O volume associado é a raiz quadrada de e.
translations.zh-Hans: 在此推导中，边界熵为 0.5 纳特，相关体积为 e 的平方根。

en.text: Alpha times the square root of e gives beta: 0.012. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.

translations.en: Alpha times the square root of e gives beta: 0.012. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.
translations.fr: Alpha fois la racine carrée de e donne bêta : 0,012. L’angle de projection vaut 6,3 degrés.
translations.pt-BR: Alfa vezes a raiz quadrada de e dá beta: 0,012. O ângulo da projeção é 6,3 graus.
translations.zh-Hans: α 乘以 e 的平方根得到 β：0.012。投影角为 6.3 度。

en.text: Reflection carries beta; transmission its complement. The S matrix preserves their sum; the angle reads the face.

translations.en: Reflection carries beta; transmission its complement. The S matrix preserves their sum; the angle reads the face.
translations.fr: La réflexion porte bêta ; la transmission, son complément. La matrice S conserve leur somme ; l’angle lit la face.
translations.pt-BR: A reflexão leva beta; a transmissão, seu complemento. A matriz S preserva a soma; o ângulo lê a face.
translations.zh-Hans: 反射承载 β，透射承载其补量。S 矩阵保持两者之和；角度是对面的读取。

en.text: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.

translations.en: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.
translations.fr: Le flot modulaire agit sur la face hyperbolique. Ses poids changeants sont lus par l’angle compact de projection.
translations.pt-BR: O fluxo modular atua na face hiperbólica. Seus pesos em mudança são lidos pelo ângulo compacto da projeção.
translations.zh-Hans: 模流作用于双曲面。变化的权重由紧致投影角读取。

en.text: The Powers ladder links the scales; Breuer’s gap keeps the finite trace available for the next construction.

translations.en: The Powers ladder links the scales; Breuer’s gap keeps the finite trace available for the next construction.
translations.fr: L’échelle de Powers relie les échelles ; le gap de Breuer maintient la trace finie disponible pour la construction suivante.
translations.pt-BR: A cadeia de Powers liga as escalas; o gap de Breuer mantém o traço finito disponível para a construção seguinte.
translations.zh-Hans: Powers 阶梯连接各尺度；Breuer 能隙使有限迹可用于下一步构造。

en.text: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.

translations.en: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.
translations.fr: J composé avec J préserve l’identité ; la conjugaison par J inverse K. Le rayon traversant suit cette inversion.
translations.pt-BR: J composto com J preserva a identidade; a conjugação por J inverte K. O raio que atravessa acompanha essa inversão.
translations.zh-Hans: J 与自身复合保持恒等；以 J 共轭使 K 反号。穿越的光线跟随这一反转。

en.text: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.

translations.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
translations.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
translations.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
translations.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

en.text: Soldering joins frame and transport. The displayed commutator turns the frame, and curvature appears.

translations.en: Soldering joins frame and transport. The displayed commutator turns the frame, and curvature appears.
translations.fr: La soudure unit repère et transport. Le commutateur affiché fait tourner le repère, et la courbure apparaît.
translations.pt-BR: A solda une referencial e transporte. O comutador exibido gira o referencial, e surge a curvatura.
translations.zh-Hans: 焊接连接标架与输运。所示对易子使标架旋转，曲率随之出现。

en.text: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.

translations.en: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.
translations.fr: La gorge suit la géométrie statique de Schwarzschild. L’hélice tournante montre 2 polarisations portées par le tenseur.
translations.pt-BR: A garganta acompanha a geometria estática de Schwarzschild. A hélice em rotação mostra 2 polarizações carregadas pelo tensor.
translations.zh-Hans: 喉部跟随史瓦西静态几何。旋转的螺旋显示张量携带的 2 个偏振。

en.text: Under H₁, H₂ and H₃, the Pentad joins Breuer, Name, coframe, Lorentz and Clausius.

translations.en: Under H₁, H₂ and H₃, the Pentad joins Breuer, Name, coframe, Lorentz and Clausius.
translations.fr: Sous H₁, H₂ et H₃, la Pentade réunit Breuer, Nom, corepère, Lorentz et Clausius.
translations.pt-BR: Sob H₁, H₂ e H₃, a Pêntada reúne Breuer, Nome, coframe, Lorentz e Clausius.
translations.zh-Hans: 在 H₁、H₂、H₃ 假设下，五元组连接 Breuer、名、余标架、洛伦兹和克劳修斯。

en.text: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.

translations.en: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
translations.fr: La relation à l’horizon donne le coefficient d’Einstein dans le noyau. La porte compte 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
translations.pt-BR: A relação no horizonte dá o coeficiente de Einstein no kernel. O gate tem 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
translations.zh-Hans: 视界关系在内核中给出爱因斯坦系数。门控包含 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

en.text: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9541 theorems.

translations.en: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9541 theorems.
translations.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. L’échelle de preuve affiche 9541 théorèmes.
translations.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. A escada de prova exibe 9541 teoremas.
translations.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。证明阶梯显示 9541 个定理。

en.text: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.

translations.en: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.
translations.fr: Le parcours se ferme à son origine : la même identité traverse miroir, transport et courbure. L’écran passe alors au test.
translations.pt-BR: O percurso fecha onde começou: a mesma identidade atravessa espelho, transporte e curvatura. A tela passa então ao teste.
translations.zh-Hans: 路径在起点闭合：同一恒等性经过镜面、输运与曲率而保持。画面随后转向检验。

en.text: Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below the threshold.

translations.en: Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below the threshold.
translations.fr: Ensemble : z calibré 4,44, p unilatéral 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste sous le seuil.
translations.pt-BR: Juntos: z calibrado 4,44, p unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo do limiar.
translations.zh-Hans: 共同显示：校准 z 为 4.44，单侧 p 为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于阈值。

en.text: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.

translations.en: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.
translations.fr: z delta -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. Log Bayes n’est pas sigma. Validité dans le noyau sous hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
translations.pt-BR: z delta -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Log Bayes não é sigma. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.
translations.zh-Hans: z delta 为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。对数贝叶斯因子不是 sigma。内核有效性成立于假设之下；自然裁决。

cues.fr: La réflexion porte bêta ; la transmission, son complément. La matrice S conserve leur somme ; l’angle lit la face.
cues.pt-BR: A reflexão leva beta; a transmissão, seu complemento. A matriz S preserva a soma; o ângulo lê a face.
cues.zh-Hans: 反射承载 β，透射承载其补量。S 矩阵保持两者之和；角度是对面的读取。

cues.en: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.
cues.fr: Le flot modulaire agit sur la face hyperbolique. Ses poids changeants sont lus par l’angle compact de projection.
cues.pt-BR: O fluxo modular atua na face hiperbólica. Seus pesos em mudança são lidos pelo ângulo compacto da projeção.
cues.zh-Hans: 模流作用于双曲面。变化的权重由紧致投影角读取。

cues.en: The Powers ladder links the scales; Breuer’s gap keeps the finite trace available for the next construction.
cues.fr: L’échelle de Powers relie les échelles ; le gap de Breuer maintient la trace finie disponible pour la construction suivante.
cues.pt-BR: A cadeia de Powers liga as escalas; o gap de Breuer mantém o traço finito disponível para a construção seguinte.
cues.zh-Hans: Powers 阶梯连接各尺度；Breuer 能隙使有限迹可用于下一步构造。

cues.en: J composed with J preserves identity; conjugation by J reverses K. The crossing ray follows this reversal.
cues.fr: J composé avec J préserve l’identité ; la conjugaison par J inverse K. Le rayon traversant suit cette inversion.
cues.pt-BR: J composto com J preserva a identidade; a conjugação por J inverte K. O raio que atravessa acompanha essa inversão.
cues.zh-Hans: J 与自身复合保持恒等；以 J 共轭使 K 反号。穿越的光线跟随这一反转。

cues.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
cues.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
cues.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
cues.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

cues.en: Soldering joins frame and transport. The displayed commutator turns the frame, and curvature appears.
cues.fr: La soudure unit repère et transport. Le commutateur affiché fait tourner le repère, et la courbure apparaît.
cues.pt-BR: A solda une referencial e transporte. O comutador exibido gira o referencial, e surge a curvatura.
cues.zh-Hans: 焊接连接标架与输运。所示对易子使标架旋转，曲率随之出现。

cues.en: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.
cues.fr: La gorge suit la géométrie statique de Schwarzschild. L’hélice tournante montre 2 polarisations portées par le tenseur.
cues.pt-BR: A garganta acompanha a geometria estática de Schwarzschild. A hélice em rotação mostra 2 polarizações carregadas pelo tensor.
cues.zh-Hans: 喉部跟随史瓦西静态几何。旋转的螺旋显示张量携带的 2 个偏振。

cues.en: Under H₁, H₂ and H₃, the Pentad joins Breuer, Name, coframe, Lorentz and Clausius.
cues.fr: Sous H₁, H₂ et H₃, la Pentade réunit Breuer, Nom, corepère, Lorentz et Clausius.
cues.pt-BR: Sob H₁, H₂ e H₃, a Pêntada reúne Breuer, Nome, coframe, Lorentz e Clausius.
cues.zh-Hans: 在 H₁、H₂、H₃ 假设下，五元组连接 Breuer、名、余标架、洛伦兹和克劳修斯。

cues.en: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
cues.fr: La relation à l’horizon donne le coefficient d’Einstein dans le noyau. La porte compte 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
cues.pt-BR: A relação no horizonte dá o coeficiente de Einstein no kernel. O gate tem 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
cues.zh-Hans: 视界关系在内核中给出爱因斯坦系数。门控包含 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

cues.en: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9541 theorems.
cues.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. L’échelle de preuve affiche 9541 théorèmes.
cues.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. A escada de prova exibe 9541 teoremas.
cues.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。证明阶梯显示 9541 个定理。

cues.en: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.
cues.fr: Le parcours se ferme à son origine : la même identité traverse miroir, transport et courbure. L’écran passe alors au test.
cues.pt-BR: O percurso fecha onde começou: a mesma identidade atravessa espelho, transporte e curvatura. A tela passa então ao teste.
cues.zh-Hans: 路径在起点闭合：同一恒等性经过镜面、输运与曲率而保持。画面随后转向检验。

cues.en: Together: calibrated z 4.44, one-sided p 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below the threshold.
cues.fr: Ensemble : z calibré 4,44, p unilatéral 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste sous le seuil.
cues.pt-BR: Juntos: z calibrado 4,44, p unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo do limiar.
cues.zh-Hans: 共同显示：校准 z 为 4.44，单侧 p 为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于阈值。

cues.en: z delta -1.48: not falsified with power. Log Bayes is not sigma. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.
cues.fr: z delta -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. Log Bayes n’est pas sigma. Validité dans le noyau sous hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
cues.pt-BR: z delta -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Log Bayes não é sigma. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.
cues.zh-Hans: z delta 为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。对数贝叶斯因子不是 sigma。内核有效性成立于假设之下；自然裁决。
